tools.name: aemet_climatology
tools.description: ONLY use this tool to fetch HISTORICAL climate averages, extremes, or past daily records. DO NOT use this tool for live forecasts (use aemet_forecast) or live sensor data (use aemet_observations). query_type MUST be exactly one of: 'daily', 'normals' (1991-2020 averages), 'monthly', or 'extremes'. Requires 'station_id' (e.g. 'valencia', 'madrid', '8416').

tools.name: aemet_fire_risk
tools.description: Fetches wildfire risk probability maps and UV radiation index predictions from the AEMET OpenData API. You MUST provide query_type as EXACTLY one of: 'fire_estimated', 'fire_forecast', or 'uvi'. Fire risk area covers 'peninsula' or 'canarias'.

tools.name: aemet_forecast
tools.description: Fetches municipal weather forecasts from AEMET OpenData API. You MUST provide mode as EXACTLY one of: 'daily' or 'hourly'. Also requires 'municipio' (name or 5-digit INE code).

tools.name: aemet_lightning
tools.description: Fetches the latest lightning strike observation map from AEMET. Returns a viewable image URL showing recent lightning activity.

tools.name: aemet_marine
tools.description: Fetches live marine/coastal weather predictions from AEMET. You MUST provide forecast_type as EXACTLY one of: 'coastal' or 'highsea'. Also requires 'zone' (e.g. 'valencia', 'alicante', 'mediterraneo').

tools.name: aemet_mountain
tools.description: Fetches mountain weather forecasts from AEMET. Requires 'area' (e.g. 'pirineos', 'sierra nevada', 'picos de europa') and 'day' (0 for today, 1 for tomorrow, etc. up to 3).

tools.name: aemet_observations
tools.description: ONLY use this tool to fetch LIVE, real-time sensor observations from AEMET stations (last 12 hours). DO NOT use this for future forecasts (use aemet_forecast) or historical averages (use aemet_climatology). query_type MUST be exactly one of: 'current_all' (all stations in Spain) or 'current_station' (specific station). Requires 'station_id' if query_type is 'current_station'.

tools.name: aemet_warnings
tools.description: Fetches live meteorological hazard warnings (rain, wind, heat, coastal, etc.) for the Valencian Community from the AEMET OpenData CAP API.

tools.name: csv_aggregate
tools.description: Performs server-side aggregation (sum, count, avg, min, max) across ALL rows of a CSV file.

tools.name: csv_list
tools.description: Lists all CSV files in the vault with column headers (schemas only, no row data).

tools.name: csv_reader
tools.description: Reads and filters rows from a specific CSV file. Geometry columns are auto-excluded.

tools.name: drive_list
tools.description: Lists files available in Google Drive recursively. Restricted to the authorized folder if configured.

tools.name: drive_read
tools.description: Downloads and extracts plain text from an authorized Google Drive file (Docs, PDFs, TXT) completely in memory.

tools.name: drive_read_sheet
tools.description: Reads structured row data from Google Sheets in Drive. Returns a list of dicts suitable for chaining.

tools.name: file_reader
tools.description: Reads, extracts, and parses local files (CSV, PDF, TXT, JSON, MD, Excel XLSX) from the vault into clean structured format.

tools.name: general
tools.description: Chit-chat, math, programming, and general reasoning without external data sources.

tools.name: icv_wms_search
tools.description: Searches the Institut Cartogràfic Valencià (ICV) Metadata Catalog for map services, datasets, and WMS links. Useful for finding data on DANA, floods, climate change, or specific maps.

tools.name: patricova_flood_risk
tools.description: Checks the official PATRICOVA Flood Risk (Riesgo de Inundación) for a location. You can provide either numeric lat/lon coordinates, OR a string location_name (e.g., 'San Vicente del Raspeig') which will be automatically geocoded.

tools.name: siscova_earthquakes
tools.description: Fetches a live feed of recent seismic events (earthquakes) from the SISCOVA Open Data CKAN API. Returns data array with fields: date, time_utc, magnitude, depth_km, latitude, longitude, municipality, province, zone.

tools.name: siscova_scraper
tools.description: Scrapes live seismic station data (locations, sensor types) from the SISCOVA HTML web portal.

tools.name: tool_discover
tools.description: Lists every registered agent tool with its full schema (name, description, parameters, required fields). Use to understand what tools are available and how to call them.

tools.name: vault_catalog
tools.description: Discovers all available data sources across local files (CSVs, PDFs, TXT), Neo4j knowledge graph, and Google Drive folder.

tools.name: vault_discover
tools.description: Scans the entire vault and returns a structured inventory of all available data: raw PDFs, indexed PDFs (Pinecone), raw CSVs, processed data (extracted tables), text/markdown files, and preprocessing scripts. Use this FIRST when unsure which file or tool to use.

tools.name: vault_pdf_search
tools.description: Search ALL company PDFs/TXT in the vault (Pinecone).

tools.name: vision_map_analyzer
tools.description: A Multimodal Vision AI tool that reads and analyzes image maps. Use this tool when you need to answer a user's question about an image map you just fetched (like AEMET Fire Risk or Lightning maps). Arguments: - image_url (str): The direct URL to the image map. - question (str): The specific question you want the Vision AI to answer about the map.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Searches the live internet using DuckDuckGo to answer general questions or find recent news. Returns short snippets of text from the top search results. Use this as a fallback if the local vault or other specialized APIs don't have the answer.
